Summary The National Account Manager (NAM), Hyatt, Lifestyle Independent, and Casinos owns three premium-aligned segments for La Colombe: the Hyatt premium brand portfolio, the lifestyle independent hotel segment, and the casino enterprise segment. These buyers share a common premium mindset across hotels and entertainment.

The NAM is responsible for driving distribution, programming, and partnership growth across the corporate, brand, and property layers within these three segments.

Responsibilities Account Ownership — Hyatt, Lifestyle, and Casinos Own corporate procurement and senior Food & Beverage (F&B) relationships within Hyatt’s upper-upscale and luxury portfolio.

Manage lifestyle independent hotel groups at the corporate and brand level, including premium resorts, urban lifestyle properties, and luxury independent operators. Own casino enterprise relationships across leading regional gaming, destination resort, and integrated resort operators.

Develop relationships with destination resort operators, including mountain, family, and integrated resort groups, at the F&B leadership level. Identify high-value individual properties as proof-point accounts across assigned segments.

Strategic Planning and Programming Develop and execute named-account business plans focused on distribution growth, account programming, and trade investment. Drive product placement, beverage program penetration, and menu integration across assigned customer brands.

Build customized Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that align with customer objectives and create mutual value. Manage Request for Proposal (RFP) cycles, Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) approval pathways, and contract renewals, including per-serving cost modeling and competitive positioning.

Relationship Management Build strong relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders across corporate, brand, regional, and property levels. Negotiate contracts that drive execution and programming while maintaining appropriate trade spend levels.

Develop customized presentations using business insights to address customer needs and secure execution and programming wins. Lead business reviews and hold partners accountable to agreed-upon execution and program goals. Participate in relevant trade shows and industry conferences.

Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with field sales teams to support property-level execution across key accounts. Collaborate with service operations on equipment standards, installation pipelines, and preventive maintenance plans. Partner with channel marketing on co-op programs, customer-facing materials, and brand activations.

Coordinate with product and delivery system teams on on-tap product deployments where applicable. Reporting and Pipeline Discipline Maintain Customer Relationship Management (CRM) records following meaningful customer interactions. Provide consistent pipeline updates and forecasts to the Sr. Director, Hospitality.

Support Quarterly Business Review (QBR) and annual planning cycles through account-level revenue, margin, and program performance reporting. Requirements 7+ years of Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) Away From Home (AFH) sales experience, with significant experience managing hotel, premium restaurant, or chain accounts at the national level.

Proven success managing complex buyer organizations, including corporate procurement, brand Food & Beverage (F&B) leadership, regional operations, and Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) relationships. Direct experience managing chain Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, contract negotiations, and per-serving cost modeling.

Strong understanding of the GPO landscape preferred. Self-motivated and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Strong analytical, presentation, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Customer Relationship Management (CRM) experience (HubSpot or equivalent) required. Prior experience selling into Hyatt premium, lifestyle independent hotels, or casino enterprise Food & Beverage programs strongly preferred.

Ability to build relationships across both corporate procurement organizations and high-touch ownership groups. EDUCATION Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree a plus. TRAVEL 30–50% travel — primarily to customer headquarters and leading premium properties.

About Us Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, while elevating our communities and making the world a healthier place. In short: making good food for all.

In support of this mission, Chobani is a purpose-driven, people-first, food-and-wellness-focused company, and has been since its founding in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, an immigrant to the U.S.

The Company manufactures yogurt, oat milk, and creamers – Chobani yogurt is America's No.1 yogurt brand, made with natural ingredients without artificial preservatives.

Following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe, a leading coffee roaster with a shared commitment to quality, craftmanship and impact, the Company began selling cold-pressed espresso and lattes on tap at cafés nationwide, as well as Ready to Drink (RTD) coffee beverages at retail.

In 2025, Chobani acquired Daily Harvest, a modern brand offering consumers nutritious, delicious and convenient ready-to-make meals. Chobani uses food as a force for good in the world – putting humanity first in everything it does. The company's philanthropic efforts prioritize giving back to its communities and beyond.

Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets. For more information, please visit  www.chobani.com or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn. Chobani is an equal opportunity employer.

Chobani will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on any basis including, but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, military and/or veteran status, marital status, predisposing genetic characteristics and genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws.

The salary range for this full-time position is $123,300.00 - $150,700.00, + bonus + equity + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Chobani provides a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, disability insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement.

To help save for the future, all employees are eligible for a 401k match of 100% on up to 5% of eligible pay. To support growing families, we provide fertility and childcare assistance, and 12 weeks of parental leave at full pay after six months of continuous employment.

In addition, we provide wellness resources which include an employee assistance program, fitness discounts, a wellness reimbursement, on-site gym access (certain locations) and a monthly wellness newsletter to connect you with resources and timely information.

We offer various types of paid time of including: 120 hours of paid time off, 11 holidays, and paid volunteer time off. Originally posted on Himalayas

Company Description
Axolabs specialises in a new class of drugs whose active ingredients are chemically derived from DNA or RNA. They are called oligonucleotide or nucleic acid therapeutics. We use our many years of expertise to help our clients make them a success. Some of these drugs have already been approved and are being used successfully against diseases that were previously untreatable in some cases. New drugs from this class are added every year.
We believe in Science for a Safer World and are currently seeking candidates who are up for the challenge of operating in a high-growth, purpose-driven organization. LGC Axolabs is located in Petaluma, US, Kulmbach and Berlin, Germany.
Job Description
Drive Growth. Build Partnerships. Shape the Future.
LGC is looking for a passionate and strategic Business Development Manager to lead at the forefront of nucleic acid therapeutics. In this impactful, fully remote role, you’ll connect with global teams, foster meaningful partnerships, and champion Axolabs’ commitment to excellence and trust.
As a Business Development Manager on our team, you will
Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities in the nucleic acid therapeutics field
Collaborate with Business Intelligence to uncover high-potential leads
Promote Axolabs as a leading, multi-site CRO/CDMO to enhance market visibility
Build and nurture strong, lasting relationships with prospects and customers
Drive business growth through a structured sales process and strategic negotiations

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; additional business qualifications are a plus
Proven experience in winning new business in the pharma, biotech, or CDMO sectors
Strong understanding of drug development and regulatory landscapes
Expertise in external communication with customers, prospects, and industry partners
Self-motivated, goal-driven and comfortable navigating complex sales cycles (additional languages are a bonus)
Additional Information
This position is fully remote within the US with a preference for someone based in the Boston, MA area.
Willing to travel up to 50%, including overnight trips, as required
Ready to make a real difference where science meets strategy? Let’s grow together
Additional Information

LGC is a leading, global life science tools company, providing mission-critical components and solutions into high-growth application areas across the human healthcare and applied market segments. Its high-quality product portfolio is comprised of mission-critical tools for genomic analysis and for quality assurance applications, which are typically embedded and recurring within our customers’ products and workflows and are valued for their performance, quality, and range.

LGC strongly believes that every job applicant and employee should be valued for their individual talents regardless of age, disability, race, color, ethnic or national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, religion, or belief.

Short listing, interviewing and selection will always be carried out without regard to gender, sexual orientation, marital status, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or belief, age, or trade union membership.
For more information about LGC, please visit our website www.lgcgroup.com

Job Description
Here at Kraft Heinz, our US Sales team aspires to be an Indispensable Partner with a Growth and Winning Mindset, acutely focused on Superior Execution every day. This is our guiding compass to grow something great and make life delicious!
This Customer Sales Manager (CSM) position perfectly embodies that ambition, as you will own & be responsible for selling and executing across various categories accounting for $45MM in revenue with Albertsons as a vital member of the team.

The CSM serves as the liaison between Kraft Heinz and the Customer’s category management team, leading all selling activities & driving efforts tied to improving our gross margin & market share.

The CSM aims to deliver revenue and share objectives, pursue business strategies to of growth, provide category management expertise, and ensure that coordinated cross-functional sales value is delivered to the customer through implementation of the sales plan and shelving objectives.

Effectively partner with the customer, building rapport at all levels to fully understand their business, the marketplace, and affect positive business growth
Achieve New Item Authorization goals, Distribution goals, & Base Business Objectives: Revenue and Share Growth, Authorizations, Distribution, Optimal Shelving
Achieve promotional revenue objectives by tactic, price point, Drive Period & Selling Event while effectively implementing Kraft Heinz pricing strategies for owned categories
Work cross functionally to effectively manage execution of all assigned category objectives
Maintain files and business documentation to thoroughly detail business transactions
Expected Experience & Required Skills
Proven & tested experience in customer management, account management, and/or retail sales management for a CPG company
Tested ability to own business process and Category management through a complex Sales position where you owned a desk of at least $10MM of business
Proven ability to manage and balance a large trade budget
Proven skills embodying a customer-first mentality for effective customer management and selling to achieve objectives
Trusted to work autonomously within a CBT framework to plan, organize and set/achieve priorities
Clear examples of exhibiting polished interpersonal skills (written, verbal, and presentation) with potential to negotiate and influence effectively
Tested proficiency in Microsoft Office programs and proprietary Sales systems such as IRI, Spark, etc
Clear examples of exhibiting strong analytical skills; Has the ability & experience using syndicated and/or ambiguous data to develop comprehensive business plans by analyzing category and brand performance and influences customer to achieve category objectives.
Willing to travel 10-20% out of the area as needed
Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values.

$96,800.00 - $121,000.00
Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.
The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors
Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future, we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Coverage for benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.
Wellbeing: We offer events, resources, and learning opportunities that inspire a physical, social, emotional, and financial well-being lifestyle for our employees and their families.
You’ll be able to participate in a variety of benefits and wellbeing programs that may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors, for example:
Physical - Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Screenings/Assessments
Social - Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Leave of Absence, Flexible Work Arrangements, Recognition, Training
Emotional – Employee Assistance Program , Wellbeing Programs, Family Support Programs

Uber Eats is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Senior Account Executive to help grow our Retail business across the United States.
In this role, you'll play a key part in expanding Uber's retail selection by bringing customers more of the brands they know and love-from nationally recognized retailers and emerging consumer brands to regional favorites and beloved local businesses. You'll prospect, negotiate, and launch new merchant partnerships across categories including Beauty, Fashion, Electronics, Home, Sporting Goods, and Specialty Retail, helping make Uber the go-to destination for consumers looking to shop on-demand.
You'll own the full sales cycle, building relationships with business owners and executive decision-makers, negotiating commercial agreements, and launching merchants onto the Uber platform. Success in this role is measured by consistently exceeding sales goals, bringing high-quality merchants onto the platform, and expanding the retail selection that keeps customers coming back to Uber.

Own the full sales cycle for prospective retail merchants, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting, and launch.
Build and manage a pipeline of new business opportunities across a diverse portfolio of retail merchants, balancing nationally recognized brands, regional retailers, and high-potential local businesses.
Develop relationships with founders, owners, and executive stakeholders to understand their business objectives and demonstrate how Uber can help drive customer acquisition, incremental sales, and omnichannel growth.
Deliver thoughtful, consultative sales presentations tailored to each merchant's business, clearly communicating the value of partnering with Uber.
Negotiate commercial agreements that establish strong, long-term partnerships and create sustainable value for both Uber and our merchant partners.
Partner closely with Operations, Account Management, Marketing, Product, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and successful merchant launches.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast while consistently achieving or exceeding monthly and quarterly business goals.
Share customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence to help inform Uber's retail growth strategy and identify new partnership opportunities.

5+ years of experience in sales, business development, account management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
2+ years of experience managing a sales pipeline and consistently delivering against quota.
Experience prospecting, negotiating, and closing new business opportunities.
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Passion for helping businesses grow through innovative technology and commerce solutions.

Experience selling into retail, ecommerce, SaaS, marketplaces, advertising, logistics, payments, or other commercial technology solutions.
Experience managing consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Proven track record of exceeding quota in a performance-based sales role.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while helping build new go-to-market motions and sales strategies.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
Coachable, curious, and motivated by building new business.

About Bellhop Bellhop is a tech-enabled managed marketplace connecting customers with vetted local and long-distance moving companies. We're a lean, fast-moving team focused on building the best experience in the industry — for our customers, our moving and carrier partners, and the people who work with us..

The Role Bellhop is hiring a Sales Manager to own the day-to-day performance of our sales team. You'll manage and coach a remote, onshore and offshore-based team of sales agents who handle inbound leads and phone/text follow-up for local and long-distance moves.

You'll build the scripts, cadence, and coaching rhythms that turn the team into a high-conversion sales engine, and determine the right team size and structure needed to hit our performance standards.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role focused on daily discipline — call monitoring, script adherence, and follow-up cadence — layered on top of the sales structure we already have in place.

What You'll Do Manage and coach a remote/offshore sales team handling inbound leads and outbound follow-up for local and long-distance moving customers Determine the right number and structure of agents needed to consistently meet our performance standards, adjusting team size as volume and goals change Build and continually sharpen sales scripts: objection handling, competitive positioning, value building, and pain discovery Set and enforce outreach cadence and follow-up discipline across our CRM and calling/texting platforms, including hitting fast lead-response SLAs Run daily quality monitoring — review calls and texts, coach agents 1:1 regardless of tenure, and turn observations into concrete script and process improvements Own lead hygiene in the CRM, ensuring every lead is properly logged, statused, and worked Track and report team performance and funnel conversion metrics, flagging opportunities and risks Partner with marketing and product on lead quality and friction points in the web booking flow What We're Looking For Proven experience managing a remote and/or offshore sales or call center team.

No moving experience required A track record of improving conversion in a phone- and text-based sales environment Strong sales fundamentals — you think in terms of a funnel, and you can coach agents to sell better regardless of how long they've been on the team Comfortable building and refining scripts, not just enforcing existing ones Hands-on and data-driven; comfortable operating without a large management layer above or below you We weigh demonstrated sales management ability over years of experience — strong sales chops matter more than tenure Nice to Have Experience with CRM and calling/texting platforms in a sales environment Experience in moving, relocation, home services, or another managed marketplace business Experience building a sales function from scratch in a lean or scrappy environment Compensation & Location Full-time, W2, remote but ideally based in Atlanta, GA or Chattanooga, TN Base salary + performance bonus/commission tied to team KPIs (conversion rate, lead response time, and other funnel metrics) Originally posted on Himalayas

Summary Are you driven by an entrepreneurial spirit? Ready to elevate your career in sales to new heights? Yelp is on the lookout for a dynamic and results-driven sales professional who has a proven track record of success in a fast-paced, high-growth company. Join Yelp’s growing Partner Sales division.

As the driving force behind this entrepreneurial venture, you will forge connections with senior executives in the local advertising industry, nurture and expand existing relationships, and orchestrate cross-functional partnerships with direct exposure to senior management within our organization.

The primary mission of the Partner Account Director 1 role is to enhance and expand Yelp’s footprint by cultivating relationships with agencies and third-party entities focused on the SMB market. These agencies collaborate with Yelp to both resell and procure our local product offerings.

The ideal candidate for this position will possess the agility to swiftly grasp the intricacies of our business and effectively convey the value of our products and partnership program. This role demands a highly motivated and dynamic individual who excels at forging strategic alliances and generating new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate thrives on a consultative sales approach, comprehending agency models, and uncovering the needs and decision-making criteria of potential clients. Ultimately, you will be accountable for achieving and surpassing revenue targets.

Please note that while this role is a remote position, it is required that the candidate resides within the Pacific or Mountain time zones of the continental US. What you'll do: Foster strong, collaborative business relationships between Yelp and SMB (mainly local) agencies and their advertisers.

Consistently surpass sales targets by delivering new partner-driven revenue every quarter. Lead the partnership and deal-origination process, overseeing every stage from strategy and planning to pipeline development, outreach, implementation, and ongoing growth.

Create compelling and consultative sales presentations that showcase how Yelp’s advertising products can effectively engage consumers. Represent our company as an advocate and spokesperson at industry events. Contribute to shaping the future direction of Yelp’s advertising partner program.

Develop and maintain partner relationships to ensure the achievement of assigned goals. Analyze agency structures, identify key decision-makers, budget holders, and the agencies' decision-making processes. Cultivate ongoing relationships with agencies, validate advertisers' needs, and maintain the prominence of Yelp’s partnership.

Collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional teams to drive revenue growth with new clients. Begin each workday with a positive attitude and a determination to succeed. Use Chatbench, Yelp’s internal tool that provides secure access to a number of LLM models, to research, draft proposals, analyze data and overcome objections.

What it takes to succeed: You have a minimum of 5-8 years of experience in agency and partner sales, business development, or digital sales roles. You are familiar with Yelp’s advertising products, APIs, and channel programs within the industry, such as those offered by Google, Bing, or Facebook (preferred).

You have a demonstrated history of successfully achieving sales targets in previous positions. You have an extensive network of contacts within the tech industry, spanning from startups to well-established brands.

Your communication skills are influential and effective across all forms, including written communication, presentations, negotiations, and attentive listening. You possess a genuine passion for our company's products, as well as other consumer internet/mobile offerings.

You have a flexible, startup-oriented mindset and can excel in a highly dynamic, fast-paced work environment. You view yourself as self-motivated, a team player, and have a strong drive to exceed targets. You are comfortable with necessary travel for the role.

(25%) What you'll get: Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental Mental health support and services via Modern Health 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday Up to 14 weeks of parental leave Monthly wellness subsidy Flexible spending account 401(k) retirement savings plan Employee stock purchase plan Professional development reimbursement Work from home reimbursement Target salary base is $92,500 This role is also eligible to earn uncapped incentive compensation (sales commissions).

Target annual compensation for this role is $160,000, which includes base salary and quarterly incentive compensation assuming minimum performance expectations are met.

About the company Founded in 2017, rePurpose Global is the leading Packaging Sustainability & Compliance platform for consumer companies.

We enable brands to measure their plastic footprint, recover plastic waste from nature through a global partner network, and streamline compliance across 45+ packaging regulations — all from one platform. rePurpose has recovered over 100 million pounds of plastic waste, supported 2,300+ waste workers, and maintains 12 active impact projects worldwide.

Our platform helps brands achieve compliance outcomes through advanced data management and regulatory expertise. Headquartered in New York. Learn more at repurpose.global. This position is remote-only for East Coast, US candidates. If you are based in New York City, we ask that you join our hybrid work environment.

About the Role The Account Manager owns commercial outcomes across a large, mixed portfolio of rePurpose Global customers. This is a quota-carrying role responsible for renewals, expansion, and long-term account growth.

You will work inside a CS pod alongside Customer Success Managers, partnering closely to develop account plans, surface opportunities, and ensure customers are getting measurable value from the platform. You will also help build the playbook — this function is new, and you will have direct influence over how it operates. Key Responsibilities
Renewals and retention
Own the full renewal cycle across a portfolio of 100+ accounts — forecasting accurately, managing risk proactively, and closing on time
Identify at-risk accounts early and partner with your pod's CSMs on retention plans before issues escalate
Negotiate multi-year agreements where appropriate
Expansion and growth
Carry an individual quota tied to expansion revenue — upsell, cross-sell, and contract upgrades across your book of business
Partner with CSMs to develop account plans that map customer goals to rePurpose capabilities and surface expansion opportunities
Manage expansion deal cycles from identification through close, coordinating with Sales where appropriate
Forecast pipeline accurately and maintain clean account data in HubSpot
Customer relationships
Serve as a primary commercial point of contact for your portfolio, building trust across multiple stakeholder levels
Conduct regular business reviews that connect customer outcomes to the value rePurpose delivers
Anticipate customer needs and bring solutions proactively — before issues become escalations
Playbook and process building
Help define and build the AM function from the ground up — this is a new motion and you will have direct influence over how it operates
Develop and iterate on account planning frameworks, renewal playbooks, and expansion triggers in partnership with CS leadership
Surface patterns across your portfolio to inform team-wide process improvements
Cross-functional partnership
Work inside a CS pod with CSMs, sharing account context, aligning on customer health, and coordinating on timing for commercial conversations
Bring structured product feedback to Product and Engineering — synthesized across accounts, not escalated one at a time
Collaborate with Sales on handoffs, expansion deal support, and pipeline coordination

3+ years in a quota-carrying account management or SaaS sales role, with documented success against renewal and expansion targets
Proven ability to manage a high-volume portfolio independently — organized, self-directed, and doesn't need every process handed to them
Strong commercial instincts: comfortable with pricing conversations, contract negotiation, and forecasting
Experience working inside a pod or cross-functional team structure, with a track record of collaborating effectively with CS or delivery counterparts
Comfortable with HubSpot or a comparable CRM — keeps pipeline clean and uses data to prioritize
AI-forward mindset — actively uses AI tools to manage volume, prioritize accounts, and improve customer interactions
Adaptable and comfortable in a startup environment with evolving processes, products, and priorities

Experience in a high-volume account management environment (100+ accounts) where prioritization and efficiency were critical
Background in sustainability, packaging, compliance, or impact-driven businesses
Experience building or contributing to a new commercial motion or playbook in an early-stage function

The role is remote only for candidates on the East Coast of the US; for those candidates located near our head office in New York City, this will be a hybrid position with 3 days per week in-office at our office at 1460 Broadway.
We have a truly global team - with members across Miami, New York, Philadelphia, Los Angeles, London, Nairobi, Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, and Jakarta.

Crum & Forster Company Overview Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. A true underwriting company, we have a 200-year history of helping our customers manage risk with laser-focused expertise, integrity and discipline.

Our people are empowered to make decisions and problem-solve with you smartly and swiftly. Our annual gross written premium is 6.2 billion. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best. Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India.

With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com Job Description The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving profitable growth in the Retail Excess Casualty Insurance portfolio through the development and management of brokers, agency, and client relationships.

This role focuses on identifying new business opportunities, expanding market presence, and collaborating with underwriting to deliver tailored excess casualty solutions.

The ideal candidate should have a deep knowledge of casualty insurance products, strong industry relationships, and a proven track record of business development within the commercial insurance marketplace.

The position works closely with underwriting leadership to align growth initiatives with business objectives but does not have responsibility for managing or servicing individual accounts. What you will do: Business Development & Sales
Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve premium growth and profitability objectives for the Retail Excess Casualty portfolio.
Identify and pursue new distribution opportunities through retail broker relationships.
Expand market penetration within targeted industries, territories, and distribution channels.
Drive awareness of underwriting capabilities, market appetite, and value proposition among key trading partners.
Support long-term business growth through strategic relationship development and market engagement.
Broker & Client Relationship Management
Participate in industry events, conferences, and networking activities to strengthen market visibility.
Build and maintain strong relationships with brokerage leadership, producers, and key agency stakeholders.
Serve as a primary market-facing representative for the Retail Excess Casualty business unit.
Conduct regular agency visits, broker meetings, and market outreach activities to strengthen partnerships.
Facilitate communication between underwriting teams and distribution partners to support business objectives.
Deliver presentations, product updates, and training sessions to brokers and agencies.
Collaboration & Market Strategy
Partner with underwriting teams to align business development efforts with risk appetite and profitability objectives.
Provide market intelligence regarding competitor activity, pricing trends, coverage developments, and emerging risks.
Assist in developing product enhancements and strategies to address evolving customer needs.
Sales Planning & Performance Management
Develop and manage business development pipelines and prospecting activities.
Track and analyze production trends, broker engagement metrics, and growth initiatives.
Support territory planning and execution to maximize market opportunities.
Contribute to annual business planning, forecasting, and strategic growth initiatives

s.h: What YOU will bring to C&F

About Reserv
Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022.

We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment.

If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

As an Account Manager (AM) at Reserv , you’ll serve as the strategic partner and relationship owner for a portfolio of key customers. You will work cross-functionally to deliver optimal claims outcomes, maximize customer satisfaction, and help shape our customers’ long-term success.
You’ll act as the quarterback of the customer relationship — proactively identifying opportunities, solving problems, managing escalations, and driving measurable results through the lifecycle of the account. This is a high-ownership role for a customer-obsessed operator with strong communication, project management, and strategic thinking skills.

Customer Relationship Management
Develop and nurture deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts.
Act as a strategic advisor, understanding your customers’ business goals, challenges, and success criteria.
Conduct regular Strategic Business Reviews (Monthly and Quarterly) to review performance, share insights, and drive continuous improvement.
Stay informed on industry trends, regulations, and competitive shifts that may impact your customers.
Retention & Growth
Serve as the voice of the customer internally — advocating for customer needs across Product, Claims, and Ops.
Identify and drive opportunities for expansion, renewals, and upsells in partnership with Sales.
Execute customer success strategies tailored to your customer segment and business priorities.
Project & Outcome Ownership
Own the overall success of the account — proactively managing escalations, requests, and ongoing initiatives.
Collaborate with internal teams (Claims, Onboarding, Escalation, Product, Sales) to ensure aligned delivery and communication.
Surface operational or tech-related friction points, develop solutions, and champion necessary process or product improvements.
Customer Journey Optimization
Support seamless handoffs from Onboarding to post-go-live engagement.
Use data and performance metrics to drive transparency, identify risks, and demonstrate value realization.
Help establish a frictionless, scalable, and advisory-driven customer experience across the CS lifecycle.

6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Services, preferably in tech-enabled services, TPA, Insurtech, or B2B service delivery
Are passionate about building strong customer partnerships and delivering measurable value
Have experience running performance business reviews or executive business reviews with enterprise customers
Thrive in cross-functional environments and can influence without authority
Possess strong organizational and project management skills — able to juggle multiple customers and priorities
Have a deep sense of accountability and ownership; you don’t let balls drop
Bring curiosity and creativity to problem solving
Are excited to help build — not just execute — a world-class CS function
Have an understanding of the P&C Insurance industry and claims value chain (a plus)

Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!
Additionally, we will
Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment
At Reserv , we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
We're looking for a driven, consultative Commercial Account Executive to spearhead DeepL's expansion across Italy , with a strong focus on strategic outbound business development.

This is an exceptional opportunity to leverage DeepL's world class brand presence and market position to proactively engage, educate, and build lasting relationships with new clients across this dynamic region.

You'll take ownership of driving the full sales process from initial strategic outreach to closing, playing a vital role in expanding our commercial footprint.
Being based in London, this role offers the chance to shape a high growth territory within Southern Europe .

You'll strategically identify target organisations, craft meaningful outreach, and partner with key decision makers in organisations up to 500 employees, seeing the direct impact of your work as DeepL solidifies its position as the go to AI translation and communication solution in Italy.

If you're energised by generating new opportunities, solving complex client communication challenges, and being part of a highly collaborative international team, we would love to hear from you.

Drive strategic outbound business development and territory growth
Lead proactive market expansion: Identify, reach out to, and build relationships with key decision makers across target commercial accounts in Italy.
Build and nurture a high quality pipeline: Design and execute thoughtful, tailored outreach campaigns across multiple channels using email, phone, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.
Become a trusted ambassador for DeepL's products and an expert on Italian enterprise needs, tailoring conversations to solve real organisational challenges.
Guide prospects through a consultative sales cycle by qualifying leads, leading insightful discovery sessions, presenting tailored solution demonstrations, and closing deals.
Maximise value for clients by exploring upselling and expansion opportunities as relationships mature.
Seamlessly manage inbound inquiries alongside your outbound initiatives to maximise territory potential.
Achieve and exceed targets in a supportive environment
Consistently work toward achieving monthly activity, pipeline generation, and revenue goals.
Maintain accurate CRM forecasting and account insights to ensure clear tracking of customer needs, timelines, and strategy.
Collaborate closely with cross functional partners including SDRs, Marketing, and Product teams to co create strategies that drive regional success.
Qualities we look for
Experience and expertise
Proven track record in full cycle SaaS sales , with strong experience in proactive prospecting, pipeline creation, and closing new business.
Experience engaging and partnering with accounts up to 500 employees.
Strong alignment with consultative sales approaches by focusing on active listening, understanding client pain points, and delivering value.
Strategic, curious mindset with a strong sense of ownership over your territory growth.
Skills and attributes
Exceptional relationship building, presentation, and communication skills both written and verbal.
High adaptability and problem solving skills, comfortable navigating dynamic, fast paced environments.
Goal oriented and persistent, with a passion for initiating business conversations and creating momentum.
Strong team player who values collaboration, mutual support, and sharing knowledge across teams.
Fluency in Italian and English is essential.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

About Atira
Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.
We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!
Why this is the most important commercial hire we make this year
Our co-founders Florian (ex-Palantir Commercial DACH Lead) and August (ex-Google ML) have personally closed every Atira deal so far with many leads coming from customer-customer referrals. We are serving Industrial players from various verticals, with six-figure ACVs and 45-60 day cycles.
You are the first commercial hire at Atira. You inherit a validated ICP, a working FDE motion that already de-risks every deal, the inbound spike from our brand initiative going live, and a co-founder who will hand you his calendar. What you build here runs on a foundation other founding AEs spend their first year constructing.
The GTM team at Atira will work from the playbook you write. This is your chance to be part of something big, early on.

s.h: How the role sits in the team
s.t: You report directly to our founders. You partner with the FDEs who deploy at each customer, the BDR who fills the top of your funnel, and the GTM Engineer who builds the systems underneath your motion.

Close new logos in DACH industrials. From large Mittelstand groups to Tier-1 enterprises
Own the full sales cycle. Discovery, demo, business case, pilot scoping, procurement, security, contract + upsell motion post deal
Multi-thread complex buying committees. Owners, Head of Sales, Head of Engineering, IT, Procurement. You map the room, find the advocate, and surface the blocker before they become a no
Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers from product demo onwards. Pull our FDEs in every call needed from demo through pilot. You introduce the product, they go deep on the technical aspects, the two of you work on the deal together
Feedback pricing, product, and ICP refinement. You see more deals across more segments than anyone else in the company within six months. That signal flows back to founders and the product team
Build the playbook the next AE will inherit

A senior closer with the political instinct to navigate an industrial buying committee. But cultural fit and ambition come first. The profile below describes two distinct paths we have in mind - both are equally valid.
Path 1: SaaS Sales background
3+ years closing complex B2B software into (German) industrial buyers. SAP, Salesforce, Dynamics, Celonis or a comparable enterprise stack sold to manufacturers. Or you sold into industrials from a credible system integrator
Carried €1M+ quota with documented attainment over consecutive cycles
Active address book in DACH Mittelstand and Tier-1 industrials. Five concrete logos where you can set the first meeting yourself in your first 30 days
Track record of closing six-figure ACVs with cycles under 90 days
Path 2: Sales Engineering Experience
You have worked in sales or sales engineering inside an industrial manufacturer and have experienced at first hand what it takes to sell engineered-to-order products
You know exactly what an RFQ looks like at 6pm on a Friday because you have lived it. You have sat across from vendors selling AI to your team and you know which ones got it wrong
You want to cross into SaaS and agentic AI and you are willing to learn the closing motion at speed. We will teach you what you do not already know
You bring real credibility with the buyers we are selling to
For both paths
Stakeholder map intuition
Full working proficiency in both German and English
Genuine curiosity about manufacturing and industrials. You do not need to know everything on day one, but you need to be the kind of person who will know in week three
What you'll get
Real ownership. First AE seat, no inherited playbook. You write the version the next five AEs will run
Direct work with Florian (ex-Palantir DACH Commercial Lead)
Validated traction. Proven track record across multiple industrial verticals
A team built around you. FDEs already deployed on customer accounts, a GTM Engineer building the systems underneath your motion, BDRs feeding the top of your funnel
Compensation built for over-performance. Competitive base & equity, uncapped variable with kickers
Central Munich office. Vibrant in-office culture additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and dinners
Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity
What success looks like after a few months
You have personally closed several new logos in DACH industrials
Florian has handed over the active pipeline and stays in the close only for the largest Enterprise deals
You conduct clean handoffs to the FDE post-signature and ensure smooth implementation
The first version of the AE playbook is documented and the next AE could pick it up tomorrow
Pricing, packaging, and ICP signal flows back to founders and engineering

Für ein etabliertes, familiengeführtes Unternehmen aus der industriellen Schlauchsystemtechnik suchen wir eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit für den Ausbau eines definierten Vertriebsgebiets in Süddeutschland (Bayern oder Baden-Württemberg).
Aufgaben
Sie entwickeln Hand in Hand mit der Vertriebsleitung Strategien zur Weiterentwicklung Ihres Vertriebsgebiets und setzen diese eigenverantwortlich um.
Sie verantworten sowohl die Gewinnung von Neukunden (etwa 40%) als auch die Betreuung von Bestandskunden.
Sie begleiten Ihre Kunden fachlich während des gesamten Projektverlaufs von der ersten Anfrage über die technische und kaufmännische Ausarbeitung bis zum Abschluss.
Sie stimmen sich eng mit dem Innendienst und den technischen Fachbereichen ab, um tragfähige Lösungen sicherzustellen.
Sie führen Vertragsverhandlungen durch.
Qualifikation
Sie verfügen über eine technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung, gerne mit entsprechender Weiterbildung, z.B. zum staatlich geprüften Techniker o.Ä.
Sie konnten bereits Erfahrung im Verkauf erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte in einem technischen Umfeld sammeln, idealerweise im Produktbereich von Schläuchen, Armaturen oder Verbindungstechnik.
Sie verfügen über eine vertriebs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unternehmerisch denkt und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernimmt.
Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, eigenständige und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.
Sie wohnen im Vertriebsgebiet (Bayern oder Baden-Württemberg) und bringen die Bereitschaft zu beruflichen Reisen innerhalb Ihres Gebiets mit.

Gehaltspaket zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 EUR p.a.
Inhabergeführtes etabliertes Unternehmen
Hohe Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung
Raum für fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung sowie ergänzende Zusatzleistungen
Connectima ist eine spezialisierte Personalberatung, Headhunter und Executive-Search-Partner für Verfahrenstechnik und Filtration.

Wir begleiten Fach- und Führungskräfte auf ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt, im DACH-Raum und international, entlang der gesamten Bandbreite dieser Branchen: von Membranfiltration, Prozessfiltration und Wasseraufbereitung über mechanische, chemische und thermische Verfahrenstechnik bis hin zu verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Armaturen, Ventilen und Wärmetauschern.

Unser Netzwerk umfasst mehr als 40.000 Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Chemie, Pharma, Maschinenbau und Umwelttechnik. Als reine Branchenspezialisten kennen wir die Unternehmen, Technologien und Entscheidungswege im Detail und beraten Sie persönlich, vertraulich und mit echtem technischem Verständnis.

Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft mentIQ GmbH zu besetzen.
Du hältst gerne die Fäden zusammen, kommunizierst verbindlich und möchtest dich im IT-Service Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln? Dann übernimm bei uns eine Schlüsselrolle zwischen Kunden, Technik, Vertrieb und Herstellern.
Seit 2007 steht mentIQ für intelligentes Datenmanagement, individuelle Lösungen und persönlichen Service. Als Teil der Medialine Group verbinden wir die Nähe und kurzen Wege eines spezialisierten Teams mit den Möglichkeiten einer größeren Unternehmensgruppe.
Aufgaben
In dieser neu geschaffenen Position arbeitest du eng mit unserer erfahrenen Service Account Managerin zusammen und berichtest direkt an unseren CIO und Leiter Technik. Zu Beginn übernimmst du vor allem koordinative und organisatorische Aufgaben. Mit wachsender Erfahrung führst du eigene Service-Themen und meisterst zunehmend auch anspruchsvolle Kundensituationen.
Was du bei uns bewegst
Service & Delivery koordinieren: Du entlastest unsere technischen Consultants bei organisatorischen Aufgaben, pflegst Einsätze und Projekte im CRM, holst bei Bedarf Tätigkeitsberichte ein und prüfst vor Projektstart, ob Equipment und Lizenzen bereitstehen.
Projekte verlässlich begleiten: Du koordinierst Übergaben und Kick-offs, pflegst Projekt- und Einsatzpläne, verfolgst Meilensteine, unterstützt bei der Übergabe an den Kunden und holst Rückmeldungen zur Kundenzufriedenheit ein.
Kundenkommunikation aktiv mitgestalten: Du koordinierst regelmäßige Service-Meetings, bereitest aussagekräftige Präsentationen und Statusübersichten vor und verfolgst die vereinbarten Maßnahmen bis zum Abschluss.
CRM- und Asset-Daten verantworten: Du übernimmst die zentrale Anlage, Aktualisierung und Qualitätssicherung der technischen Kunden-Assets im CRM. Dazu gehören Informationen zu Hardware, Software, Konfigurationen, Services, Laufzeiten, Wartungsverträgen und SLAs. Damit schaffst du eine verlässliche Datengrundlage für die Serviceerbringung und anstehende Wartungsverlängerungen.
Tickets aktiv nachverfolgen: Du prüfst offene, geschlossene und länger laufende Support-Tickets, holst Statusinformationen ein und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt.
Serviceleistungen und Kontingente koordinieren: Du behältst vereinbarte Dienstleistungskontingente und noch offene Leistungen im Blick, vergleichst geplante mit bereits erbrachten Leistungen und stellst die notwendigen Informationen für Auftragsabwicklung und Abrechnung bereit.
In Verantwortung hineinwachsen: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Service-Meetings, koordinierst Eskalationen und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden.
Qualifikation
Passender Hintergrund: Eine kaufmännische, serviceorientierte oder administrative Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung – entscheidend ist, dass du organisieren und mit Menschen arbeiten kannst.
Struktur und Verbindlichkeit: Du arbeitest sorgfältig, setzt Prioritäten, hältst Zusagen nach und bleibst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen handlungsfähig.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du formulierst klar, freundlich und lösungsorientiert – intern ebenso wie gegenüber Kunden und Partnern.
Interesse an IT-Services: Du möchtest technische Zusammenhänge verstehen, musst aber zum Einstieg noch keine tiefgehende technische Expertise mitbringen.
Sicherer Umgang mit Werkzeugen: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Microsoft Office; Erfahrung mit CRM-, Ticket- oder Projektmanagement-Systemen ist ein Plus.
Sprache: Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher mit Kunden, Herstellern und Partnern abstimmen.

Persönliche Einarbeitung: Du lernst direkt an der Seite unserer Service Account Managerin und arbeitest eng mit dem CIO sowie unserem Technik- und Vertriebsteam zusammen.
Ein echter Entwicklungspfad: Du startest mit klar umrissenen Aufgaben und übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung – bis hin zur eigenständigen Betreuung von Services und Kunden.
Gestaltungsspielraum: Als Teil eines wachsenden Servicebereichs kannst du Abläufe, Datenqualität und Kundenerlebnis sichtbar mitgestalten.
Abwechslung und Wirkung: Bei dir laufen Informationen zusammen. Damit hilfst du, Projekte verlässlich umzusetzen, Probleme schneller zu lösen und Kunden langfristig zu begeistern.
Dein Weg in der Rolle
Zum Einstieg: Koordination, CRM- und Datenpflege, Meetingvorbereitung und konsequentes Nachhalten.
Mit wachsender Erfahrung: Eigene Arbeitspakete, Service-Meetings sowie Verantwortung für kleinere Services und Kunden. Perspektivisch: Steuerung komplexerer Kundensituationen, Eskalationen und eigenständiges Service Account Management.
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wenn du Freude daran hast, Menschen, Aufgaben und Informationen zusammenzubringen, findest du bei uns eine Rolle, die mit dir wächst.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.
In unserer Bewerberansprache setzen wir auf das 'Du'. Solltest Du eine andere Ansprache bevorzugen, lass es uns einfach wissen und wir passen uns Deinen Präferenzen an.

About Emerald Emerald ’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce.

We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels.

For more information, please visit ASD Market Week is one of the largest and longest-running business-to-business general merchandise trade shows in the United States.

Held twice annually in Las Vegas, ASD connects thousands of retailers, distributors, importers, and e-commerce businesses with manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers from around the world.

With more than 1,800 vendors, approximately 30,000 attendees, and over one million products across 19+ merchandise categories, ASD provides exhibitors with a powerful platform to meet new customers, enter new markets, build brand visibility, and write business directly on the show floor.

We are seeking a motivated, commercially driven Account Executive to grow exhibitor and sponsorship revenue for ASD Market Week. The Account Executive will manage the complete sales cycle—from identifying and prospecting new business opportunities through discovery, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and renewal.

This role will primarily engage manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, importers, suppliers, and consumer-product brands that would benefit from reaching ASD’s diverse community of retail buyers.

Proven record of meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.

Are you a seasoned sales professional with expertise in pumps and water systems, ready to drive growth across our Industry market? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.
Founded in 1923, Peerless Pump Company (a Grundfos subsidiary) is a US-based manufacturer of horizontal and vertical centrifugal pumps for fire, industrial, and municipal applications.

With pump installations in 145 countries, Peerless is globally recognized for engineering tough, reliable, and versatile pump solutions with extensive flow and pressure capabilities.

From our production facilities in Indianapolis and Houston to our service centers in Lubbock and Fresno, Peerless pumps are designed to protect people and property from fire and to bring water where it’s needed most. Our product quality is second to none, but it’s our people who’ve made us Peerless for over 100 years.

Our legacy of innovation is fueled by attracting, training, and retaining employees from diverse backgrounds. With competitive benefits and a strong emphasis on development, growth, and innovation, Peerless employees come seeking a job but stay to build a career.
As our new District Sales Manager, you will be managing and developing Peerless Pump sales through business partners and direct channels across the South Central (Houston or Dallas), formulating winning sales strategies, building strong distributor and contractor relationships, and driving revenue to meet or exceed established targets.
You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.
You can be based anywhere in Houston or Dallas, Texas and will work remotely.
What makes you a great fit
Above all, you are a results-driven sales professional with 5+ years of experience in pump markets, strong technical acumen to read and interpret project specifications, and the communication and leadership skills to inspire business partners and win new business. We would also imagine that you have:
A Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field with 5-10 years of experience in pump sales or a closely related industry.
Strong understanding of pumps, their markets, and applications across Industry segment.
Professional sales skills including key account strategy development, pricing negotiation, and business partner management.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with high proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and e-business tools.

Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

Addepar’s Enterprise Sales team partners with some of the largest wealth management firms globally, including many listed on the Barron’s Top 40.

# Regionaler Verkaufsleiter - Ostschweiz - Nestlé Waters #
**Standort:** Einsatzgebiet Ostschweiz
**Arbeitsmodell:** Aussendienst / Vollzeit
**Vertragsart:** Unbefristet
** **
**Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.**
** **
Als Regionaler Verkaufsleiter - Ostschweiz bei Nestlé Waters ist Ihre Mission, die Weiterentwicklung des Out-of-Home-Geschäfts in Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Gemeinschaftsverpflegung, Freizeitbetrieben, Events und bei regionalen Handelspartnern voranzutreiben.

Sie machen einen Unterschied, indem Sie ein regionales Verkaufsteam führen und weiterentwickeln, die kommerzielle Strategie wirkungsvoll verankern und regionale Marktkenntnisse sowie Kundenbedürfnisse in die nationalen Out-of-Home-Strategie einbringen.

Diese Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, Wachstum, Profitabilität und eine starke Markenpräsenz in der Region Ostschweiz nachhaltig zu sichern. Diese Aufgabe bietet Ihnen die Chance, die Zukunft der Getränke aktiv mitzugestalten - und Erlebnisse zu schaffen, die den Alltag vieler Menschen bereichern.
**Wie Sie als Regionaler Verkaufsleiter - Ostschweiz Wirkung entfalten**
* Führung eines regionalen Verkaufsteams von 8-10 Mitarbeitenden, inklusive Coaching, Leistungsorientierung, Talententwicklung und Schaffung eines motivierenden Arbeitsumfelds.
* Umsetzung der nationalen Verkaufsstrategie in konkrete regionale Massnahmen, verbunden mit Zielsetzung, Priorisierung, Planung und Steuerung aller Verkaufsaktivitäten.
* Einbringung fundierter regionaler Marktkenntnisse, Kundenperspektiven und Wettbewerbsbeobachtungen zur Weiterentwicklung der Out-of-Home-Strategie und optimalen Nutzung lokaler Chancen.
* Überwachung von Umsatz, Volumen, Margen und weiteren Leistungskennzahlen sowie Ableitung wirksamer Massnahmen zur Sicherung nachhaltigen und profitablen Wachstums.
* Ausbau langfristiger, profitabler Beziehungen zu Kund:innen, Partnern und Verkaufsstellen sowie Identifikation, Gewinnung und Entwicklung strategisch wichtiger Neukund:innen im OOH-Umfeld.
* Einführung neuer Produkte und Initiativen bei Partnern und Verkaufsstellen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance und Key Account Management zur Stärkung der regionalen Marktumsetzung.
** **
**Was Sie erfolgreich macht**
** **
* Erfahrung im Verkauf oder Key Account Management sowie ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Markt- und Kundenbedürfnisse, idealerweise in der Getränke- oder Gastronomiebranche.
* Erfahrung im Getränke-, Gastronomie- oder Out-of-Home-Umfeld und Kenntnisse seiner Dynamiken.
* Erfahrung in Führung und Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden, verbunden mit der Fähigkeit, ein leistungsorientiertes, motivierendes Umfeld zu schaffen und Talente gezielt zu fördern.
* Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Stakeholder zu überzeugen, verbunden mit unternehmerischem Denken und einem sicheren Verständnis für Umsatz, Margen und Profitabilität.
* Anwendung einer strukturierten, analytischen und datenbasierten Arbeitsweise, unterstützt durch CRM-, Reporting-Tools und SAP.
* Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (fliessend) und Französisch (gute Kenntnisse); Englisch ist von Vorteil.
* Verkörperung unserer Werte: Care, Grit, Connection und Ingenuity.
** **
**Bei Nestlé Waters stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt**
** **
Unsere Benefits sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihre persönliche Entwicklung und Ihr Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen - damit Sie im Beruf und im Leben aufblühen können:
* Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, inkl. Hybrid-Optionen (für Office-basierte Rollen)
* Überdurchschnittliche Ferienregelung
* Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Leistungsorientierter Bonus
* Gesundheitsbeiträge & Employee Assistance Program
* Attraktive Arbeitgeberbeiträge zur Pensionskasse
* Grosszügige Elternurlaube & umfassende Familienunterstützung
* Attraktive Mitarbeitendenrabatte auf zahlreiche Produkte und Services
** **
**Was Sie in unserem Bewerbungsprozess erwartet**
** **
Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Bewerbungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützung zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig barrierefrei und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit Einrichtungen und Prozessen, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.
Der Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Fachbereich sowie ein abschließendes Gespräch mit Angebot. Wir prüfen eingehende Bewerbungen fortlaufend und schliessen die Stelle, sobald wir eine überzeugende Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen identifiziert haben - daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market.

In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals.

This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.
You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.
This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.
This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

Industry experience . You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
An advertising technology expert . You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
A trusted advisor and consultant . You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
A high-energy, passionate self-starter . You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller . You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
A proactive problem solver . You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
Eager, curious, and a fast learner . You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to drive the growth of our data center thermal management business in North America.
This role will focus on developing strategic relationships with hyperscale data centers, AI infrastructure companies, server/OEM partners, system integrators, and other key players across the data center ecosystem.
The ideal candidate combines strong business development capabilities with hands-on knowledge of data center cooling technologies , particularly liquid cooling and advanced heat-transfer solutions. This is a highly entrepreneurial position for someone comfortable independently developing a market, building customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through commercial execution.

Business Development & Market Expansion
Develop new business opportunities within the North American data center and AI infrastructure market.
Identify and engage hyperscalers, OEMs, system integrators, data center operators, and other strategic customers.
Build and manage a strong pipeline of new accounts, projects, and partnership opportunities.
Independently drive the full business development cycle, from prospecting and initial engagement to technical discussions, commercial negotiations, and project conversion.
Key Account Management
Develop and maintain relationships with key customer stakeholders across engineering, procurement, supply chain, infrastructure, and business teams.
Identify opportunities for account expansion, new programs, product upgrades, and additional applications.
Establish long-term customer relationships that support recurring and scalable revenue.
Solution & Technical Selling
Promote thermal management products and solutions for next-generation data center and high-performance computing applications.
Work with technical and engineering teams to understand customer requirements and develop appropriate thermal solutions.
Support customer discussions involving liquid cooling, cold plate technologies, heat exchangers, air cooling, and related thermal management architectures .
Translate customer technical requirements into actionable commercial opportunities.
Market Intelligence & Partnerships
Monitor developments in AI infrastructure, high-density computing, liquid cooling, and data center technologies.
Identify potential channel, technology, and ecosystem partners in the North American market.
Provide market feedback regarding customer requirements, competitive landscape, technology trends, and emerging opportunities.
Industry Engagement
Represent the company at relevant data center, AI infrastructure, thermal management, and technology industry events.
Participate in customer visits, technical seminars, conferences, and trade shows as needed.

5+ years of experience within the data center, electronics, thermal management, or related infrastructure industry .
3+ years of sales or business development experience in North America.
Direct experience selling data center thermal management, liquid cooling, cold plates, heat exchangers, cooling systems, or closely related infrastructure solutions .
Strong understanding of data center cooling technologies and the differences between liquid and air cooling architectures.
Demonstrated success developing new customers and building business opportunities from the ground up.
Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles involving technical and commercial stakeholders.
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote, entrepreneurial environment.
Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events, and business development activities.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal/Fluid Sciences, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Business, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Existing relationships within the North American AI infrastructure, hyperscale data center, OEM, server, system integration, or colocation ecosystem .
Experience supporting major cloud service providers, AI computing companies, or large-scale data center customers.
Experience with high-density computing and next-generation liquid cooling applications.
Established relationships with engineering, procurement, supply chain, or infrastructure decision-makers.
Previous experience launching or expanding a product line or business territory in North America.
Experience working in a global or cross-border organization is a plus.

This position is particularly well suited for a hunter-oriented business development professional who understands both the technical and commercial sides of the data center cooling market.
The successful candidate should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, developing new relationships from scratch, navigating technical customer organizations, and turning early-stage opportunities into long-term strategic accounts.
